scope: Complete chunk coverage and nonblocking provider startup; not next-version acceptance

chunk_contract.vector_spool: Anonymous temporary file, no raw source text

tested_behaviors: Unicode and overlap boundaries through 140000 code points
tail marker beyond old prefix retrieved via embedded Qdrant
identical current results through semantic REST and MCP
many chunks do not crowd out distinct article results
revision guard rejects search after a later edit
empty article embeds title without source modification
safe progress logs include page counts, durations, failure class and bounded HTTP 402 status
real synthetic Git bootstrap completes without calling held embedding provider
API health, exact page read and page listing remain available while background embedding is held

provider_boundary.embedding: deterministic synthetic vectors, no paid provider calls
provider_boundary.qdrant: real embedded client in memory, not hosted server
provider_boundary.remote_git: real disposable local bare Git remote
provider_boundary.held_provider_test: event-controlled provider; real ASGI API and lifecycle worker
